message: お引っ越し

name: Azel
message: 「Hyah」
The moment Azel walked into my room, she thrust her outstretched middle finger straight into the pillar.

name: Synn
message: 「Um... what are you doing?」

name: Azel
message: 「It hurts」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, yeah, of course it does」

name: Azel
message: 「A jammed finger」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Azel
message: 「Lolotte told me that when moving in, I should jam my finger and say, 'I may be unworthy, but I'm in your care'」

name: Synn
message: 「There's way too much to unpack there」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's not jamming a finger, it's kneeling with three fingers on the floor」

name: Azel
message: 「Lend me a blade」

name: Synn
message: 「Why a blade?」

name: Azel
message: 「I heard it is an old custom to cut off the pinky and thumb to show sincerity」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's barbaric」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't have to do anything like that. Actually, please don't\s02」

name: Azel
message: 「Then what should I do?」
I bowed my head.

name: Synn
message: 「Nice to have you around for a while」

name: Azel
message: 「In this case, I am the one imposing on you」
Azel cleared her throat and bowed her head to me.

name: Azel
message: 「I'm in your care」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Same here」
Azel is wearing her uniform so her favorite outfit doesn't get dirty while cleaning. I guess she really likes those clothes that much.

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um, is there anything I can help with?」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm finished」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Oh, I see, still, isn't there something?」

name: Azel
message: 「My apologies, there isn't」

name: Helena
message: 「Looks like you managed to move in just fine」

name: Synn
message: 「When did you get here!?」

name: Azel
message: 「W-Where did you come from!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even Sasami didn't notice her... This woman's definitely no ordinary person」

name: Helena
message: 「Congrats, Azel-chan! And to Synn-chan, the landlord here, I'm giving you this!」

name: Azel
message: 「W-What is this?」

name: Helena
message: 「It's a commemorative trophy for Azel-chan's Adult Level going up by 10!」

name: Azel
message: 「What is an 'Adult Level'?」

name: Helena
message: 「I mean, you suddenly started living together with a boy! Of course it's gonna jump by 10」

name: Synn
message: 「D-Don't just blurt out weird stuff like that!\s01 Besides, why am I getting it?」

name: Helena
message: 「Azel-chan. Keep leveling up more and more from now on and become a fine woman! Well, I'm busy, so bye-bye for now!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yahoo! I came to help ya out!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, we already finished」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, no. You're forgetting something super important, aren't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Something important?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「When it comes to moving, it's gotta be moving-in soba! Borrowing your kitchen!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oryaaah!」

name: Azel
message: 「...Do you need help with anything?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nope! Me, pro! Amateurs, in the way!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oryaaah, dosseh!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Zudadadadadadada」

name: Nanaka
message: 「All done!」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」

name: Azel
message: 「...Delicious」

name: Paqy
message: 「Damn good」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh. The wasabi hits hard! Straight to the nose! So good, so good!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You really call anything and everything 'so good,' don't you」

name: Synn
message: 「Because it is good! Delicious!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Flattering me like that won't get you anything extra, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong?」

name: Azel
message: 「Nothing」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn looks so happy」

name: Synn
message: 「Eating good food makes me happy! Delicious!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't hold back, eat as much as you want! There's plenty for seconds」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」

name: Sally
message: 「I smell soba! I wanna eat!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hold on a second, I'll get yours ready right now」

name: Sally
message: 「Yay! I love you too, Nanaka!」

name: Sally
message: 「Huh? What's up, Azel? Doesn't it taste good? Then give it to me!」

name: Azel
message: 「Take it」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh! I love you too, Azel!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Azel, you don't have to do that. I'm getting Sally's portion ready right now」

name: Azel
message: 「I don't want any more. Thanks for the meal」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sparks are flying pretty casually over here」

name: Sally
message: 「It's so yummy! Giving away something this tasty--how weird!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wonder if she's got an upset stomach or something. I'll go check on her for a bit」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Yeah. I'm worried about her too」

name: Sally
message: 「Nom, nom! Well then, I'm gonna eat it all up while the President and Azel aren't here!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!」

name: Azel
message: 「...Your soba will get soggy」

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong?」

name: Azel
message: 「Nothing's wrong. I just got full」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, as long as you're okay」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm tired. I'm going to sleep for a bit」

name: Synn
message: 「Got it. Let me know if you need anything, okay?」

name: Azel
message: 「I don't need anything」

name: Azel
message: 「Sigh...」

name: Azel
message: 「It's illogical... He and Nanaka have known each other a long time... Besides, the soba is delicious too...」

name: Azel
message: 「Him talking with Nanaka is nothing new... It's normal」

name: Azel
message: 「...And if it's normal, feeling irritated is irrational」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel... Azel...」

name: Synn
message: 「Is she still asleep?」

name: Azel
message: 「What is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「The photos should be ready by now, wanna go pick them up?」

name: Azel
message: 「Ah!」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm going!」

name: Azel
message: 「What about Nanaka?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm back. I was worried about you, Azel.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Is that so.」

name: Synn
message: 「Show me the photos.」
Azel tightly clutched the photo shop's envelope to his chest, turned around, and

name: Azel
message: 「No.」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't want to look at them?」

name: Azel
message: 「I do. I want to look at them so badly I can't stand it, but...」

name: Azel
message: 「No. Precisely because of that, I'm going to hold off until we get to your house.」

name: Synn
message: 「Couldn't hold out, could you.」

name: Azel
message: 「Shut up.」
Azel pulled the developed photos out of the photo shop's envelope.

name: Synn
message: 「How are they?」

name: Azel
message: 「They're all out of focus. This one, and this one, and this one!」
Not only were they out of focus, some had blurry subjects, some were washed-out white from bad exposure, and others were so dark you couldn't tell what was in them.

name: Azel
message: 「What a thoroughly inconvenient contraption. It doesn't do what I want at all. Why would anyone go through all this trouble?」
Even as he said that, Azel looked like he was having a great time.

name: Synn
message: 「What about this one?」
It was a shot of Misasagi-senpai eating traditional Japanese sweets.

name: Azel
message: 「For this one, I was supposed to have focused on Akane Misasagi, yet the focus is on the sweets.」

name: Synn
message: 「Meaning?」

name: Azel
message: 「It's a failure.」
The demons who had attacked Azel were in the photos, too.
Perhaps because they had been suddenly blasted with light, all of them had their eyes wide open.

name: Azel
message: 「This one... the light was too strong.」

name: Azel
message: 「This one is out of focus, too... and this one here is blurry and too dark.」

name: Azel
message: 「And look at this one, it's pitch black! How terrible is the performance on this thing?」

name: Synn
message: 「But photographers take pretty pictures with this camera, right?」

name: Azel
message: 「...Even I know there's no way I'd take good ones right from the start」
In the end, not a single shot turned out the way Azel intended.

name: Azel
message: 「Even I have to laugh at such clumsiness」

name: Synn
message: 「What are you gonna do with these?」

name: Azel
message: 「Keep them, of course. They're mementos」

name: Synn
message: 「I see」

name: Azel
message: 「They're flawed and useless, yet... I'm fond of all of them」
The old Azel would have thrown them away without a second thought.

name: Azel
message: 「I've certainly become quite irrational」
Saying that, she gives a shy smile.

name: Synn
message: 「Tomorrow. We have to go show Melilot-san, right?」

name: Azel
message: 「That's embarrassing... though I suppose I must」

name: Synn
message: 「Welcome home」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're supposed to say 'I'm home,' ya know」

name: Azel
message: 「...I'm home」

name: Soltia
message: 「What a bleak room」

name: Azel
message: 「What's the meaning of a sudden home visit?」

name: Soltia
message: 「Barely attending class, grades barely above failing, no relatives to speak of, and even living with a guy--wouldn't it only be natural for a teacher to worry?」

name: Azel
message: 「How earnest of you」

name: Soltia
message: 「Just kidding」

name: Soltia
message: 「Still, I did do a few home visits. Acting the part of a serious student teacher is exhausting, you know」

name: Azel
message: 「It suits you better than expected, though」

name: Soltia
message: 「Stop it」

name: Azel
message: 「What do you want」

name: Soltia
message: 「I was just passing by, so I thought I'd drop in」

name: Azel
message: 「Hmph」

name: Soltia
message: 「An angel living with a mere human--you're acting just like a human yourself」

name: Azel
message: 「Angels are nothing special」

name: Soltia
message: 「How unlike you to say something like that」

name: Azel
message: 「What do you know about me?」

name: Soltia
message: 「You said the exact same thing three months ago」

name: Azel
message: 「Then there's no issue」

name: Soltia
message: 「Back then, you said it while looking down on everything from on high with contempt」

name: Soltia
message: 「But now... you're saying it to mean that you're no different from them」

name: Soltia
message: 「When we first met, you were hard and transparent like crystal, pure like fresh water without a single impurity--you looked like my ideal angel」

name: Azel
message: 「Ideal?」

name: Soltia
message: 「Right now, you're like a human or a Demon」

name: Azel
message: 「...I am God's agent」

name: Soltia
message: 「Indeed. Whatever a tool thinks is of no concern to the one using it」

name: Azel
message: 「A tool?」

name: Soltia
message: 「Well then, I'll take my leave. Make sure you finish the geometry assignment I gave you last week」
